posts.title: You can ask your coding agent for a selector to compare UI options
posts.description: One of the ways I have been using coding agents these days is to prototype small UI changes in an existing project. I use them as a tool to explore. In this usage mode, I am not interested in the code. I am interested in how the options look. posts.description: This week I made a refactor to remove a job ( ActiveJob::Base ) that was used only in recurring.yml , and call a class method directly instead. posts.title: MdRecord: File-backed models for Rails
posts.description: I just released md_record , a Ruby gem that provides an ActiveRecord-like interface for markdown files with YAML frontmatter. Why? I needed a simple way to manage content like blog posts and guides in my Rails apps without a database. I wanted something that felt like ActiveRecord but worked with markdown files.
